title: FloodGuard planning assessment overlay
description: The planning assessment of one case under the signed planning protocols v1a and v1b: one row per unit, lane, flood input and scenario, with its evidence tier, the five component records and their echoed inputs, the FPPS, the binding v1 class with its reason code, the would-be class, the v2 class as a secondary axis, the confidence record and its basis, leave-one-component-out, the headline-stability slot, and the rights, input and protocol hashes. Planning guidance for preparedness and post-event prioritisation: not an official warning, non-operational, and accepted_fpps and accepted_action_class stay null because the qualified tier T4 is locked. Class E never means safe. Cross-field arithmetic (FPPS, class rule, would-be class, leave-one-component-out, lineage, rights minimum) is checked by floodguard.planning_overlay and by the web parser.

count.description: A measured quantity (residents, area): finite and not negative.

instant.description: A date and time with a time zone (RFC 3339).

productId.description: The identifier of a source product. unosat_product_4009 declares UNOSAT/GISTDA product 4009.

tier.description: Evidence tier (protocol v1a evidence_tier_model.tiers). T4 is locked in this release.

actionReasonCode.description: The six reason codes of class rule v1 and the one code the planning overlay adds (protocol v1a class_rules.v1.reason_codes and added_reason_code).

assignedConfidenceClass.description: A confidence class a row may carry. high requires tier T4, which is locked, so it is never assigned (protocol v1a confidence_rule_v1.high).

conditionId.description: The eight conditions of confidence rule v1.

publicationLevel.description: Guardrail GR6: local, pitch or public, lowest first.

protocolSha256.description: SHA-256 of the two signed protocol files the values were produced under (protocol v1a change_control).

weights.description: The published default weights of frame v1 (protocol v1a scoring_frame.weights, decision D4).

case.description: The case the overlay belongs to. A fixture case is invented and is not a place.

input.description: One input in the lineage of the overlay, with its hash, its rights level, the source product it declares and, for a flood input, its acquisition date.

allOf.$comment: Only a flood input carries an acquisition date; null says it has no single date.

scoringFrame.description: The frame header exactly as floodguard.normalisation.frame_record returns it: weights, anchors, the leave-one-component-out weights and the disclosure that one flood input drives 4 of 5 components (guardrail GR3).

leave_one_component_out_weights.description: For each component, the weights with it at 0 and the other four renormalised (drafter reading DR-A02).

lane_disclosure.const: One flood input drives 4 of 5 components (90% of weight). This sentence appears on the overlay and in the brief appendix.

syntheticComponent.description: A synthetic component value of an engine row (tier T0, lane ENG): a fixture or boundary-grid value, not a place and not a frame v1 record.

components.description: The five FPPS components. A frame v1 record echoes its inputs; null says the protocol states no value for the unit (the component is not computed).

t2SkillCondition.description: As floodguard.confidence.t2_skill_condition returns it (protocol v1a t2_skill_bar).

derivedConfidence.description: The confidence record exactly as floodguard.confidence.derive_confidence returns it (rule v1, per unit and lane).

allOf.$comment: Rule v1, scenario rows (DR-A07): a tier T1 record is a scenario record; C2 is the scenario declaration. An observed record never states by_scenario_declaration.
Rule v1 C1: tier T3 passes it.
Rule v1 C3: by_construction is recorded exactly when the coverage is declared by construction.
Lane SCN-ENV is the agency season layer, used as provided: it has no single acquisition date.

declaredConfidence.description: The confidence of an engine row (tier T0): declared per row, not derived by rule v1 (protocol v1a evidence_tier_model, tier T0).

closureRule.description: Protocol v1b closure_rule_v1: the level used, and closure_basis, because a flood intersection does not prove a road closure.

lineage.description: Guardrail GR3 (lane purity): the one flood input, the one routing context and the one closure rule of the row.

scenario.description: The scenario declaration of a tier T1 row: the named perturbation or assumption.

met.description: true or false for a trigger that was evaluated; null for a trigger that no stage evaluated. A trigger that was not evaluated is never written false.

classV2.description: Class rule v2: a predeclared secondary axis, never binding (decision D6). no_v2_trigger is reported as 'no v2 trigger met'; not_evaluated says that the result depends on a trigger no stage evaluated, so no v2 class is stated; null says the unit gets no v2 class under guardrail GR1.

leaveOneComponentOut.description: For each component: the FPPS with that component's weight at 0 and the other four renormalised, and the v1 class of that FPPS (drafter reading DR-A02).

headlineStability.description: Guardrail GR8: a class is headlined only with at least 60 percent retention over the single-state ensemble; otherwise it is shown as unstable: verify. The slot stays not_evaluated until the ensemble has run.

row.description: One unit in one lane with one flood input and one scenario. The binding class is the v1 class (action_class); would_be_class is never binding; class_v2 is a labelled secondary axis.

allOf.$comment: Protocol v1a date_rule: lane SCN-ENV is a season window, never a dated extent.
